description: On desktop, a focused app's window (Halonic Inbox or Halonic Messenger) may bring Studio's main window forward, or open it when it was closed, through show_main_window, which its "Open Halonic" button calls while it has no workspace to open (HAL-18188). The command takes nothing and shows only Studio's window. Studio's own window doesn't get it, and it is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets nothing.
